item.title: Stop 'reactions' to email by adding a postfix header (2024)
item.description:
📝 It is annoying that I need to set a specific header for this. But at least there is this header. I added # add header to deal with unwanted Microsoft reactions (2024-07-16) /^Date:/i PREPEND x-ms-reactions: disallow (Edit: originally, I put this line before the Content-Transfer-Encoding header.
